run_hand_tracking_evaluation: run the hand tracking evaluation on MP4 videos with unknown skeleton calibration using a pretrained model
run_find_input_output_files: run _find_input_output_files to discover MP4 input files and their corresponding NPY output paths in a directory
run_track_sequence_and_calibrate: run _track_sequence_and_calibrate to collect scale samples and produce a calibrated hand model from a video stream
run_track_sequence: run _track_sequence to process a single video, track hand keypoints, and save results as a pickle file
run_main_evaluation_pipeline: run the main evaluation pipeline that loads a pretrained model, finds test videos, and tracks hands in parallel
